ns2:section.sectionText: Priority for registration is given to ADV, CS+ADV, and Ag COMM majors who started their collegiate coursework prior to or in Fall 2021. The course will not open outside of these guidelines. *Students must register for the lecture and one discussion section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Advertising or Agricultural Communications or Computer Science & Advertising or Ag Communications-Advertising major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
